title: Private Console: Network Path Storyboard & Upgrade Rehearsal (prototype)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and prototype an interactive ‘Network Path Storyboard’ for the Private/VPC Console that helps tenants rehearse cluster upgrades and connectivity changes before they are applied. The storyboard surface should let operators: 1) narrate a connectivity scenario across logical layers (tenant app -> VPC route -> cluster node -> egress), 2) step through simulated events (maintenance window, node drain, route failover) with visualized latency and cost delta annotations, 3) surface automated risk flags derived from recent health metrics and policy guardrails, and 4) emit a shareable checklist and rollout plan (canary steps + rollback). Goal: reduce upgrade fear and on-call churn by making network impacts explicit and actionable for SREs and tenant owners. Prototype scope for this ticket covers the storyboard interaction patterns, a compact risk summary card, and a cost-annotation overlay tied to the batching/throughput estimate model. Does not include backend simulation engine integration (separate ENG ticket).
